annotations.title: Look up Brazilian companies by CNPJ

description: Look up Brazilian companies by CNPJ in the Receita Federal open data. Returns one row per company with legal and trade name, registration status, legal nature, size, share capital, main and secondary CNAE activities, address, phones, email, Simples and MEI options, and tax regime; with partners on, one row per partner or administrator (QSA).

cnpjs.description: CNPJs to look up, 14 digits with or without punctuation (07.526.557/0001-00 or 07526557000100). An 8 digit root reads the head office. Up to 10,000 per run. In Clay, put the column inside a one item list.

dedupe.description: true (default) reads a CNPJ once per run even when it appears twice. The repeat is not charged.

include_partners.description: true adds one row per partner or administrator (QSA), charged per partner. Default false.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_partners_per_company.description: Most partner rows per company, 1 to 1000. Default 100.
